question: At a ceiling of 48 local fits, does the already frozen ordinary expanded catalogue improve accuracy relative to the teammate's same-budget entry on the two other outer folds? The earlier nine solves tested an additional reflection policy. The exploratory ordinary-versus-teammate difference there was +20/4865. It does not count as independent confirmation.
inputs: Use the same complete course training partition and exact-group five-fold seed as remaining_fold_qualification. Use outer folds 3 and 4. No scores have been computed on those two specific outer partitions for these frozen solutions. Course training rows have appeared in earlier experiments.
resources: Each solve gets an identical anonymous packet, no method hints, verified local table weight, 1800 s and at most 48 actual fits including final fitting. Four new cold runs. Seal an independent fresh-process replay from every run before scoring any of the four.
qualification: Predeclared primary is the difference on folds 3 and 4 alone: neither fold may regress and pooled gain must be at least 0.003. In addition, require at least 0.003 overall across all five held folds. Report both estimates and grouped paired uncertainty separately. Apply no search over thresholds, variants or mixtures. Only if both conditions hold run the exact qualifying ordinary program on the raw designated validation features and compare once beside the sealed local anchor. The previous remaining-folds policy and its failed gate are unchanged. No formal test or H2.
